private_archive.inspection_scope: Authenticated file-tree metadata only; prior archives were not restored, extracted, or opened for outcomes.
private_archive.finding: The private tree contains prior experiment archives, manifests/receipts, and result shards. It exposes no unused independently sourced video assets or measured mobile-network input datasets.

selected_content.independence: All four selected sources are distinct capture groups marked reserve, not stage-one captures in the N1 pool; none overlaps the V11C content source IDs or V3–V10 generated scenes.
selected_content.visual_review: Selected segments reviewed: cicada emergence, Vižanice outdoor scene, helicopter firefighting scene, and D3 tree-layout tutorial. No identifiable person is retained in the selected clips. The unselected GNU/Linux screen recording visibly includes a desktop filename; the unselected IBAI clip includes an identifiable speaker. Neither is registered or captured.
selected_content.derivatives: Only 30-second no-audio H.264 Main 640x360/30 fps derivatives are served; originals and derivative clips remain in external cache, outside Git. Browser reference pixels are transient; capture evidence stores scalar quality and source IDs only.

sources.campaign_title: NordicDat cross-border LTE and 5G-NSA drive-test campaign
sources.attribution: Topi Miekkala, Pasi Pyykonen, and Georgios Drainakis, “NordicDat: A Cross-Border Predictive QoS Dataset,” Zenodo, 2024, CC BY 4.0.

sources.campaign_title: Rome active speedtest campaign across two anonymized operators
sources.attribution: Konstantinos Kousias et al., “A Large-Scale Dataset of 4G, NB-IoT, and 5G Non-Standalone Network Measurements,” Zenodo, 2023, CC BY 4.0.

selected_network_sources.source_independence_note: The four network families are nested in two independently collected datasets/campaigns. NordicDat contributes three anonymized operator/RAN/band strata; Rome contributes a separate anonymized operator LTE stratum. Repeated 18-second windows and Rome Speedtest_Campaign IDs are nested source segments, not independent network campaigns.
selected_network_sources.privacy_minimization: The derivation reads only time, downlink throughput, service status, anonymized operator, radio technology/band, UE mode and campaign. Location, cell, mobility and other identifiers are not retained or emitted.
selected_network_sources.interpretation_limit: These are actual field-measured throughput histories replayed as local queue service rates; they are not live mobile transport, packet traces, or an estimate of Internet-path effects.

alternatives_and_exclusions.source: UCC and Vienna source files used by V11C
alternatives_and_exclusions.reason: They are reused V11C network inputs and therefore do not supply new independent network families.
The repository bundles FCC, 3G/HSDPA, Oboe and Puffer traces with separate upstream provenance; the repository-level MIT license does not establish rights for each included dataset.

workspace_and_environment.network_impairment: CAP_NET_ADMIN is not available to this process; use the already qualified TURN/TCP userspace relay with measured-rate replay, not live OS network shaping.

non_pooling: V3–V10 are frozen and not modified or pooled. V11C failed its all-session gate with outcome telemetry unopened; its content/network sources and outcomes are not pooled. NordicDat strata, repeated trace windows, and Rome Speedtest subcampaigns are nested; only two dataset campaigns are counted.
